newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet steady but busier, Med touch perkier.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet steady but busier, Med touch perkier.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were steady on Wednesday with premiums holding and futures only marginally stronger. Med talk was $1 firmer or so on the back of improved local demand.
April IPE gas oil last traded up 25 cents at $172.50 a tonne.
NWE barges were pegged at a steady April IPE gas oil +$17.50 fob and a deal was concluded at this number. A 10,000 tonne cargo was also sold on Wednesday at a fixed price of $188 fob NWE.
In the Mediterranean EU spec jet was heard talked around fob high quotes +$8-9 although as high as +$10 was understood offered. Non EU grades was around high fob quotes +$5.
"We are seeing a touch more interest and there is not a lot of good quality EU barrels about," said one trader who added that a cargo has been looking for a home since last week.
